product_overview: The Ijazah Management System is a culturally authentic, secure, and scalable platform designed to manage Quranic certification applications, scholar profiles, certificate issuance, and verification. It incorporates role-based dashboards, multi-step application processes, and integrated notifications, supporting both English and Arabic (RTL) locales with a seamless user experience for students, scholars, and administrators.
core_goals: Provide a comprehensive digital platform for managing Ijazah applications from submission to certification.
Ensure secure authentication and role-based access control for students, scholars, and admins.
Enable scholars to manage student applications, biographies, and certificate issuance efficiently.
Facilitate public verification of certificates via QR codes and verification APIs.
Maintain a user-friendly, modern, and culturally respectful interface with RTL support for Arabic.
Deliver reliable notifications through in-app and email channels to keep users informed.
Implement robust security measures including two-factor authentication and role validation.
key_features: Complete authentication system supporting email/password and Google OAuth with session management and protected routes.
Multi-step Ijazah application form with validation, document upload, and draft saving.
Role-based dashboards for students, scholars, and admins featuring statistics, quick actions, and management tools.
Certificate management including generation, viewing, verification with QR codes, and downloadable PDF templates.
In-app notification system with bell icon, notification center, real-time updates, and user preferences.
Public pages including landing, about, scholars directory, FAQ, contact, and certificate verification pages.
Admin tools for user, scholar, application, and certificate management alongside system settings and audit logs.
Support for RTL layout and Arabic typography for complete bilingual user experience.
Reusable UI components built on Radix UI with Tailwind CSS ensuring design consistency.
Email notification service with templates for system events and transactional communications.
user_flow_summary: User registration and login via email/password or Google OAuth with secure session and two-factor setup.
Students can submit multi-step Ijazah applications, save drafts, upload supporting documents, and track application status in their dashboard.
Scholars review assigned applications, manage their biographies and students, and issue certificates through the scholar dashboard.
Administrators oversee all users, scholars, applications, and certificates with tools for analytics, reporting, settings, and audit trail.
Public visitors access landing pages, browse scholars directory, submit inquiries, and verify certificates via QR code or certificate ID.
Users receive real-time and email notifications about application updates, approvals, certificate issuance, or system alerts.
Users can update profiles, security settings, appearance preferences, and notification options from their settings dashboard.
validation_criteria: Authentication flow correctly enforces user roles and protected routes without unauthorized access.
Multi-step application form validates inputs, uploads documents securely, and allows draft saving.
Certificate issuance results in correctly formatted PDF certificates with embedded QR codes, verifiable by public API.
Notification system delivers both in-app and email notifications as configured by user preferences.
RTL support correctly reflects Arabic layout throughout the application without UI glitches.
Admin dashboards provide real-time data, filtering, and management capabilities across users, applications, and certificates.
Public verification page accurately validates certificate authenticity and logs all verification attempts.
All core pages achieve performance benchmarks with page load times under 3 seconds and Lighthouse scores above 90.
